2607.07391.title: MIRA-Math: A Benchmark for Minimal Information Requesting and Mathematical Reasoning
2607.07391.paper_summary: Mathematical reasoning benchmarks typically provide all facts needed to solve each problem, while interactive benchmarks often mix reasoning with tools, retrieval, and long-horizon dialogue. We introduce MIRA-Math, a benchmark for a narrower diagnostic capability: solving mathematical problems whose full latent state has a unique answer, but whose solver-facing view is missing exactly one necessary atomic fact. The solver must request the missing information in natural language under a strict budget and then integrate the returned fact into an exact final answer. A fixed constrained LLM responder sees only the dataset-provided atomic fact and must either offer the quoted fact when the request matches it, or decline otherwise. Thus, instance generation, typed hint specifications, validation, and final-answer verification are deterministic, while request metrics are measured under a fixed LLM-mediated responder channel. MIRA-Math contains 2{,}310 generated instances from 22 typed mathematical families spanning algebra, probability, linear systems, discrete structures, signal processing, Markov chains, circuits, interpolation, and numerical boundary-value problems. Experiments across frontier and small models show that request success and final-answer accuracy are separable: models may ask for the right fact yet fail the downstream computation, or fail before obtaining the canonical hint. We release generators, verifiers, prompts, run metadata, and dataset documentation to support reproducible evaluation of minimal information requesting in mathematical reasoning.
2607.07391.paper_summary_zh: 數學推理基準通常提供解決每個問題所需的所有事實，而互動基準則經常將推理與工具、檢索和長期對話混合在一起。我們介紹了 MIRA-Math，一個針對更狹窄診斷能力的基準：解決其完整潛在狀態具有唯一答案的數學問題，但其面向解題者的視圖缺少恰好一個必要的原子事實。解題者必須在嚴格的預算下以自然語言請求缺失的信息，然後將返回的事實整合到精確的最終答案中。固定約束的 LLM 回應者僅能看到數據集提供的原子事實，必須在請求與之匹配時提供引用的事實，否則拒絕。因此，實例生成、類型提示規範、驗證和最終答案驗證是確定性的，而請求指標則是在固定的 LLM 媒介回應者通道下測量的。MIRA-Math 包含來自 22 個類型數學家族的 2,310 個生成實例，涵蓋代數、概率、線性系統、離散結構、信號處理、馬爾可夫鏈、電路、插值和數值邊界值問題。跨前沿和小型模型的實驗顯示，請求成功與最終答案準確性是可分的：模型可能請求正確的事實，但在下游計算中失敗，或者在獲得典型提示之前就失敗。我們發布生成器、驗證器、提示、運行元數據和數據集文檔，以支持數學推理中最小信息請求的可重複評估。
2607.07391.author: Charbel Al Bateh et.al.
